Both intermediates are targets of 7Alpha-Hydroxycholesterol, indicating a shared interaction pathway. The presence of multiple targets in the network suggests that 7Alpha-Hydroxycholesterol may modulate Toll-like receptor 4 through a series of enzymatic and signaling interactions. The integration of these pathways highlights the possibility of a broader regulatory mechanism involving lipid metabolism and immune response modulation.
